camel_example: aliyun csas ListDynamicRoutes --region cn-hangzhou --Status Enabled --DynamicRouteIds.1 'dr-30108b6c9d310000' --PageSize 10 --CurrentPage 1 --NextHop 'connector-8ccb13b6f52c0000' --TagId 'tag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000' --RegionIds.1 'ap-southeast-1' --ApplicationId 'pa-application-e12860ef6c480000' --Name dynamic_route_name --force
description_en: Retrieves information about all dynamic routes for the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 获取当前阿里云账号下所有动态路由的信息
kebab_example: aliyun csas list-dynamic-routes --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --name dynamic_route_name --status Enabled --dynamic-route-ids dr-30108b6c9d310000 --region-ids ap-southeast-1 --application-id pa-application-e12860ef6c480000 --tag-id tag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000 --next-hop connector-8ccb13b6f52c0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDynamicRoutes

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the dynamic route. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 动态路由名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the dynamic route. Valid values:

Enabled: The dynamic route is enabled.

Disabled: The dynamic route is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
动态路由状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the dynamic routes. You can specify up to 100 dynamic route IDs
parameters.help_zh: 动态路由ID集合。最多可输入100个动态路由ID
parameters.name: dynamic_route_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of regions where the SASE POP cluster endpoint is supported
parameters.help_zh: SASE的POP集群接入点支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the private access application for the dynamic route. You cannot filter by both the private access application ID and the private access tag ID. You can obtain the ID from the following sources:

[ListPrivateAccessApplications](~~ListPrivateAccessApplications~~): Queries multiple private access applications.

[CreatePrivateAccessApplication](~~CreatePrivateAccessApplication~~): Creates a private access application
parameters.help_zh:
动态路由的内网访问应用ID。无法和内网访问标签ID同时过滤。取值来源：
[ListPrivateAccessApplications](~~ListPrivateAccessApplications~~)：批量查询内网访问应用。
[CreatePrivateAccessApplication](~~CreatePrivateAccessApplication~~)：创建内网访问应用
parameters.name: application_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the private access tag for the dynamic route. You cannot filter by both the private access tag ID and the private access application ID. You can obtain the ID from the following sources:

[ListPrivateAccessTags](~~ListPrivateAccessTags~~): Queries multiple private access tags.

[CreatePrivateAccessTag](~~CreatePrivateAccessTag~~): Creates a private access tag
parameters.help_zh:
动态路由的内网访问标签ID。无法和内网访问应用ID同时过滤。取值来源：
[ListPrivateAccessTags](~~ListPrivateAccessTags~~)：批量查询内网访问标签。
[CreatePrivateAccessTag](~~CreatePrivateAccessTag~~)：创建内网访问标签
parameters.name: tag_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the next hop instance for the dynamic route. You can obtain the ID from the following source:

[ListConnectors](~~ListConnectors~~): Queries multiple connectors
parameters.help_zh:
动态路由下一跳实例ID。取值来源：
[ListConnectors](~~ListConnectors~~)：批量查询Connector
parameters.name: next_hop
